name: Sticker Explainer
vibe: Cut-out presenter with a white sticker outline on warm grid paper; blue rounded words on pearl die-cut stickers, handwritten asides, one iridescent glitter title — friendly, calm, the picture may stay quiet.

reference.creator: Zara Zhang
reference.what: the whole look: white-outline cutout, #F2EFE6 grid paper, blue rounded type on pearl die-cut stickers, hand notes, semantic emoji, holo glitter hero/number, progressive list with person aside, 01-badge top-left, quiet face time

reference.creator: sticker-talk-edit skill (MIT)
reference.what: written rules: shot grammar A–I, sizes, colours #3D49DA / #F66D63, sway ±0.6–1.3° over 3–6 s, glitter fixed to the surface

density: Every shot of the video sits on the cutout stage (cover the whole timeline with sticker_* shots). New sticker only when a new idea is said; 1–3 stickers per screen, 0 is fine. Clear back to the bare cutout between ideas — about 40% of the time shows only the person (+ badge). Hero title at most once per 10–15 s.
not: not a caption-heavy short: no word-by-word karaoke blocks, no thick black outlines, no all-caps bars
not loud: no shake, no zoom punches, no flashing colours, no floating emoji streams
not dark/glassy (that is the cutout_card / neon look): always light paper, blue ink, one coral for negation
not every word in a different style: one rounded face, one hand face, one blue

brand.note: brand colour becomes the sticker ink (readable shade); hero holo title keeps its rainbow

fit.good_for: 知识讲解、教程、列清单、亲切友好的产品介绍
fit.avoid: 要很强冲击力的广告、节奏很快的促销
